description: Check whether a mortgage escrow payment is right under the federal escrow rules (RESPA, Regulation X): 1/12 of the yearly property tax and insurance bills, plus any shortage spread over 12 months, with a cushion of at most 1/6 of the bills. Compares with the servicer's new amount if given. Use for "my escrow went up", "is my escrow payment too high".

escrow_balance.description: Escrow balance now, from the latest statement.

insurance_yearly.description: Yearly homeowners insurance paid from escrow.

next_payment_month.description: Month (1-12) of the next mortgage payment. Default next month.

other_monthly.description: Mortgage insurance or flood insurance paid monthly from escrow. Default 0.

property_tax_yearly.description: Yearly property tax paid from escrow, in dollars.

servicer_new_escrow.description: The new monthly escrow amount the servicer quoted (escrow only), to compare. Optional.

tax_months.description: Months (1-12) the tax installments are paid, e.g. [6, 12]. Default [12].

name: check_escrow
title: Check a mortgage escrow payment
